facts.control_label: inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear

setpoint.label: periodic inspection interval for lifting gear

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: The inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear shall be provided and maintained wherever this standard applies, and its condition shall be treated as a critical control. The periodic inspection interval for lifting gear shall be set at 3 months. This clause applies to activities archived under LIFTING-AND-SUSPENDED-LOADS at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
